capabilities: Rank notes by semantic similarity to the active note in a sidebar panel
Search the whole vault by meaning against a typed query
Suggest inline wikilinks and rank [[ completions by relevance
Generate a vault insights report of suggested links, orphans, duplicates and stale notes
Render a vault map of clustered, auto-labelled notes
extras: Desktop only (Electron required). One-time model download (~110 MB WASM, ~470 MB WebGPU) from the Hugging Face Hub; fully offline afterwards. The optional reader model is off by default and downloads 1-5 GB depending on machine. Also installable via BRAT or manual release files; deeper technical detail lives in a separate ARCHITECTURE.md.
problem: Obsidian only surfaces note connections you have explicitly linked or tagged, so topically related notes stay hidden without manual linking work.

relations.evidence: it works with or without the easy-links plugin

summary: Sidebar panel that ranks notes semantically similar to the active one using a local multilingual embedding model, with semantic search and link suggestions.
